note: Leads are not verified parsers. Ranks are assigned only among verified paths.

leads.name: sqlparser_derive
leads.reason: Proc-macro helper for sqlparser's AST visitors; no parser.

leads.name: datafusion-sql
leads.reason: DataFusion SQL planner over sqlparser ASTs; shared sqlparser-rs family, no own parser.

leads.name: sqlformat
leads.reason: Formatter; tokens to text, no syntax tree.

leads.name: pg_query
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: pg_query::parse returns the libpg_query protobuf parse tree; both valid controls equal the oracle. Verified with a clang 23.1.3 build of the vendored libpg_query sharing one LLVM profile with the Rust binding, and AFL++ feedback from the Rust crates plus the gram.c, scan.c and parser.c objects (nm-checked).

leads.name: sqlite3-parser
leads.family: SQLite grammar (lemon-rs port of SQLite's Lemon parse.y)
leads.reason: Parser::new(&Bump, bytes) yields Cmd/Stmt AST values from the generated Lemon parser; both valid controls equal the oracle (string literals unquoted by the adapter). Verified with Rust source coverage of the crate and its generated parse.rs and whole-binary cargo-afl feedback.

leads.name: polyglot-sql
leads.reason: SQL transpiler with its own parser.

leads.name: qusql-parse
leads.family: qusql-parse hand-written lexer and recursive-descent parser
leads.reason: Found in the recorded 'sql parser' search snapshot (3,272 recent downloads). parse_statements(sql, &mut Issues, &ParseOptions) returns typed statements; both valid controls equal the oracle with the default MariaDB dialect. Successor of sql-parse by the same author.

leads.name: spg-sql
leads.family: spg-sql hand-written PostgreSQL-dialect lexer and recursive-descent parser
leads.reason: In the recorded 'sql parser' snapshot. parse_statement returns the SPG front-end AST; both valid controls equal the oracle.

leads.name: sqlglot-rust
leads.reason: In the recorded 'sql parser' snapshot. parse_statements(sql, Dialect::Ansi) returns a typed AST; both valid controls equal the oracle.

leads.name: nom-sql
leads.reason: parse_query_bytes returns a SqlQuery AST; both valid controls equal the oracle (decimal rebuilt from Real {integral, fractional}).

leads.name: sql-parse
leads.family: qusql-parse hand-written lexer and recursive-descent parser (predecessor)
leads.reason: Predecessor name of qusql-parse: its repository README says the project moved to the qusql-parse folder of antialize/qusql, and 50.5% of sql-parse 0.28.0 source lines reappear in qusql-parse 0.12.0 (difflib over the 21 common file paths). Excluded as a predecessor name, as trust-dns-proto was for hickory-proto.
